standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: The number of people in the world is growing fast – every year there are about 70 million more people.
entries.zh: 世界人口增长得很快——每年大约多出 7000 万人。

entries.en: So, we've got two questions that need answers: Have we got enough space on our planet for so many people? And how can we make sure they've all got enough food to live?
entries.zh: 所以我们有两个问题需要回答：我们的星球有足够的空间容纳这么多人吗？我们怎样才能确保他们都有足够的食物生存？

entries.en: Many people eat too much meat – steaks, beef burgers, sausages, etc.
entries.zh: 很多人吃了太多的肉——牛排、牛肉汉堡、香肠等等。

entries.en: That's not good for us and we need big farms to produce all that meat.
entries.zh: 这对我们不好，而且我们需要大片农场来生产这么多肉。

entries.en: The farms already use 30% of all the world's land: they create greenhouse gases and use a lot of water and energy.
entries.zh: 这些农场已经占用了全世界 30% 的土地：它们产生温室气体，还消耗大量的水和能源。

entries.en: However, we can do something to help.
entries.zh: 不过，我们可以做些事情来帮忙。

entries.en: We can eat meat only one or two days a week, for example, and eat more vegetables – that's healthy.
entries.zh: 比如，我们可以每周只吃一两天肉，多吃些蔬菜——这样很健康。

entries.en: We can also eat some different types of meat – creepy-crawlies!
entries.zh: 我们还可以吃一些不同种类的肉——让人起鸡皮疙瘩的小虫子！

entries.en: That's right, grasshoppers, worms, flies and lots of other insects.
entries.zh: 没错，蚱蜢、蠕虫、苍蝇还有很多其他昆虫。

entries.en: They're the superfood of the future.
entries.zh: 它们是未来的超级食物。

entries.en: They've got a lot of protein.
entries.zh: 它们含有大量蛋白质。

entries.en: Protein is very important for our health, and it's good for our hair and our skin.
entries.zh: 蛋白质对我们的健康非常重要，对头发和皮肤也有好处。

entries.en: Protein keeps our muscles and bones in good condition, too.
entries.zh: 蛋白质还能让我们的肌肉和骨骼保持良好状态。

entries.en: There are two more reasons why insects are good food options: insect farms don't need so much water and energy.
entries.zh: 昆虫成为优质食物还有两个原因：昆虫农场不需要那么多水和能源。

entries.en: Also, they don't use so much space.
entries.zh: 而且，它们也不占那么多空间。

entries.en: For some people in countries in Asia and Latin America, eating insects is not unusual.
entries.zh: 对亚洲和拉丁美洲一些国家的人来说，吃昆虫并不稀奇。

entries.en: But for people in Europe and many other countries, it seems very strange.
entries.zh: 但在欧洲和许多其他国家，这看起来很奇怪。

entries.en: What about you?
entries.zh: 你呢？

entries.en: Do you eat any healthy food?
entries.zh: 你吃健康食品吗？

entries.en: How much meat do you eat in a week?
entries.zh: 你一周吃多少肉？

entries.en: Perhaps you think you don't eat insects?
entries.zh: 也许你觉得你不吃昆虫？

entries.en: But maybe you're wrong!
entries.zh: 但也许你错了！

entries.en: Why's that?
entries.zh: 为什么呢？

entries.en: Because the red food colouring that is in many things that we eat comes from … an insect called the 'cochineal beetle'!
entries.zh: 因为我们吃的很多东西里的红色食用色素来自……一种叫“胭脂虫”的昆虫！

entries.en: Thank you for watching.
entries.zh: 感谢观看。
